{{Quote|What does any warlord find of value in new territory? He wishes only to conquer, to hold, and to exploit. That is all that matters to such beings. ''[&hellip;]'' He was preparing to conquer or destroy our own world when we fled. ''[&hellip;]'' To this day, we do not know which was its fate.|Vaantaar, to the Hand of Judgment|<ref name="Choices" />}}
A [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] was the '''homeworld''' of the [[Troukree]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Choices" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Refuge">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. As the [[Troukree]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] were on [[Poln Major]] during the novel's events, they must have fled their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], which [[Nuso Esva]] was about to attack, by 0 ABY.</ref> the [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] was preparing to [[Conquest of the Troukree homeworld|conquer]] the planet, prompting a group of Troukree led by [[Vaantaar]] to flee the world and join [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Empire of the Hand]], which [[Nuso Esva–Empire of the Hand conflict|opposed]] Esva's [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]]. The Troukree [[refugee]]s later settled on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet of [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> Vaantaar told the [[Hand of Judgment]], a group of five [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Desertion/Legends|deserters]], that [[Gender/Legends|he]] and his refugees did not know their homeworld's fate. After bringing the Hand of Judgment to his [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'', Thrawn told the group that the Troukree homeworld had suffered after Esva conquered it.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Troukree homeworld was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
